name: plangate-child-amends-its-own-ceiling
description: The child's OWN escape valve, end to end: a delegated enforcing child hits a handle OUTSIDE its inherited ceiling, the gate raises a plan_amendment routed to the human who owns the tree, the human APPROVES, and the child's out-of-ceiling call then PROCEEDS. Paired mirror of plangate-child-inherits-enforcing-ceiling (the DENY half): SAME fixture, only autoApprove vs autoDeny of the child's plan_amendment differs, so catalog_read_gadget flipping from IsError to a real result is caused by the amendment decision and nothing else. This is the 'request authority' path the plan-gate-meets-delegation model leaned on but that was only unit/code-proven before -- a child cannot self-clear (select_phase/update_plan are withheld from a delegated child), so the ONLY way it widens its reach is by asking, and this proves the ask reaches a person and takes effect. Reachable as a bronze bundle only now that a headless child's interaction decision is actually delivered to its Await (the inprocess_runner_factory fix) and there is a child-with-tools fixture to exercise a non-empty inherited ceiling. pcc-lead runs the plan gate at LOGGING and freezes a one-phase read ceiling {perm:list:pcc_widget}; the ONLY enforcing gate is the child's. pcc-worker (enforcing, no update_plan) auto-runs catalog_read_widget (IN ceiling, tier-0 cleared), then calls catalog_read_gadget (perm:list:pcc_gadget, OUT of ceiling): the gate raises the amendment (Verdict Allow + Approval), autoApprove answers YES, and the call falls through to a real gadget result -- proving the approved amendment widened the child's own ceiling rather than changing nothing. Asserts on the child's TOOL RESULTS via agentClass scoping: widget non-error, gadget non-error and carrying the gadget datum. autoApprove:[plan_phase] is DELIBERATELY ABSENT so a tier-0 regression on the widget phase hangs rather than passing on a masked approval. agentReplyContains is the blocking assertion.
